marks.gloss_en: אפשר גזרו על התערובת דמאי ומסתייעא מילתא דרב אסי למיכל איסורא? השתא בהמתן של צדיקים... צדיקים עצמן לא כל שכן -- Rav Assi cannot have been brought to eat the forbidden
ורבן גמליאל ובית דינו נמי כרבי מאיר סבירא להו -- the stam grounds the vote in R' Meir's fear of a minority
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: they found them with the image of a dove on top of Mount Gerizim, which they worshipped
וכדתניא: ישראל משומד משמר שבתו בשוק מבטל רשות (no SupportKind names כדתניא)
an apostate Jew who keeps Shabbat in the market renounces and transfers domain; one who does not, does not
נפק רבי זירא דק ואשכח, דתנן: ... והן עצמן מותרין מפני שהן תערובת (no SupportKind names a cited mishna)
R' Zeira: they did not decree on a demai mixture -- it is permitted (is it possible that Rav Assi would come to eat the forbidden?)
למאי? אי לשחיטה ויין נסך -- מהתם גזרו בהו רבנן! -- the decrees on their slaughter and wine were made generations earlier
אינהו גזור ולא קבילו מינייהו, אתו רבי אמי ורבי אסי גזרו וקבילו מינייהו -- the earlier decree was not accepted; this one was
ולא גזרו על תערובת דמאי? והתניא ... עשי לי משליכי -- חושש לשאור ותבלין שבה
the baraita: one who gives his neighbour dough to bake or a pot to cook need not be concerned for her leaven and spices
שאני התם, דכיון דקאמר לה עשי לי משליכי, כמאן דעריב בידים דמי -- there he mixed it as if by hand
שאני שאור ותבלין, דלטעמא עביד, וטעמא לא בטיל -- leaven and spices are for flavour, and flavour is not nullified
ולחלופי לא חיישינן? והתנן: הנותן לחמותו ... מפני שחשודה מחלפת המתקלקל
התם כדתניא טעמא -- R' Yehuda's reason (= p_ry_rotza_betakanat_bita): a special motive, not a general suspicion
the premise the three challenges probe: one is not concerned that the other party exchanged [tithed for untithed]
R' Zeira accepted R' Yaakov bar Idi's rejection of his restriction
the old man to R' Shimon ben Elazar: 'put a knife to your throat if you are a man of appetite' (Prov 23:2)

R' Chiyya: the verse's plain sense concerns a student before his teacher -- if the teacher can answer him, ask; if not, consider, and 'put a knife to your throat': if you are a man of spirit, separate from him
the old man to R' Yitzchak ben Yosef: there are no Torah-keepers here
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: 'complete gentiles' means as to renouncing and transferring domain [for an eruv]
because they said: a Jew transfers and renounces domain, but with a gentile only by renting
how? he says 'my domain is acquired by you' or 'is renounced to you' -- the other acquires, and need not perform an act of acquisition
at an inn they were served eggs cooked down in wine; R' Zeira did not eat
but the [bought] products themselves are permitted, because they are a mixture
but if he said 'make it for me from yours', he must be concerned for her leaven and spices, for shevi'it and for tithes
